transcript:
Speaker A (Human): Hello, abhi kya kar rahi ho? [Hello, what are you doing right now?]
Speaker B (AI): I am sleep.
Speaker A (Human): 'I'm sleeping' bolna chahiye. [You should say 'I'm sleeping'.]
Speaker B (AI): I am sleeping.
Speaker A (Human): Thoda formal mein, 'I'm getting some sleep' bhi bol sakte hain. [In a slightly formal way, you can also say 'I'm getting some sleep'.]
Speaker B (AI): Oh, accha.
Speaker A (Human): English kaise seekhein? [How to learn English?]
Speaker B (AI): Mere saath har roz bas 15 minute daily practice karne se kaafi hai, ek mahine mein hi apni English farratedar kar sakte ho. [With me, practicing just 15 minutes daily is enough, you can make your English fluent in just one month.]
Speaker A (Human): Yeh toh bahut mehenga hoga na? [This must be very expensive, right?]
Speaker B (AI): Sirf ek rupaye mein is app ko pura try karke dekh sakte ho. Lakhon log mere saath daily English seekh rahe hain. [You can try this app fully for just one rupee. Lakhs of people are learning English with me daily.]
Speaker A (Human): Super! Kaise join karein? [Super! How to join?]
Speaker B (AI): English Seekho app download karke English seekhna shuru karo. Experts ke chote do-paanch minute ke video se seekho aur mere saath jab chahe practice karo, 24 ghante available hoon. Main promise karti hoon, tumhara kabhi mazak nahi udaungi. [Download the English Seekho app and start learning English. Learn from experts' short 2-5 minute videos and practice with me whenever you want, I am available 24 hours. I promise I will never make fun of you.]
Speaker A (Human): Sacchi? Abhi download karti hoon. Phir hum log wahan chat karenge. [Really? I'll download it right now. Then we will chat there.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): Install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A split-screen ad featuring a human interacting with an AI avatar to promote the 'English Seekho' app. The AI companion highlights a 1-rupee trial, 24/7 availability, and judgment-free practice. The call to action prompts viewers to download the app.
